profile.headline: Software Engineer at Comcast Technology Solutions
profile.summary:
Multifaceted Frontend & iOS Engineer with passion for making complex visual concepts come alive with code. With a strong analytical mind and visual aptitude I can manage full app development cycle from ideation, user-experience, interface design to development.

Web Development
Expertise: JavaScript, React.js, Flux, D3.js, Backbone.js, jQuery, HTML5 & CSS3
Experienced in: Angular.js, Ember.js, Git, Webpack, Gulp, Browserify, Require.js, Python, PHP, Node.js, MySQL, MongoDB, RESTful API
APIs: Facebook, Twitter, Amazon, Netflix, iTunes and YouTube

App Development
iOS Development with Objective-C/Cocoa and C. Knowledgeable of Swift.
Tools & Frameworks: CocoaPods, Core Data, AVPlayer/AVFoundation, CollectionViewController, UITableViewController, UIPageViewController, RestKit, Core Graphics, Core Plot, Core Location, UIImagePickerController

Special Skills
Design and Wireframing

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
Design and develop mobile apps for autism community.

SocialCue: Released August, 2015. The purpose of this iOS app is to help autistic people learn how to behave and interact with people in a socially acceptable manner using videos. What sets this app apart is the movie quality videos and intuitive, beautiful user-interface.

Technologies and frameworks: Core Data, AVPlayer/AVFoundation, CollectionViewController, Container View Controller, UITableViewController, UIPageViewController, UIViewControllerInteractiveTransitioning

positions.title: Lead Senior Developer
positions.description:
Front-end architect and developer for the app named theAudience Direct for connecting big name brands with influencers for the purpose of using their influence to reach large audiences. The architecture is based on Flux, in combination with React.js for views, and Browserify for dependency management, and Gulp for build management.

Develop and maintain the company internal app titled Backstage that enables social media content creators and administrators to create contents, get client’s approval, schedule posts and view data analytics using Backbone.js and Require.js. The latest release featured auto scheduled post publishing using the Chronos API, a distributed, fault-tolerant scheduler that is a replacement for Cron. I led in researching for possible technologies and solutions, implement prototypes and coming up with a secure way to communicate with Chronos.

I also took the lead role in redesigning and rearchitecting the Backstage administration section using React.js for views and Backbone.js for models, transitioning from pure PHP solution, thereby streamlining the user-experience and resulting in a modern user-interface.

I’ve written data analysis and visualization tools using D3.js with Python or PHP as backend. These tools are used to analyze various social media metrics. Mathematically inclined and highly visual, I excel and revel in coming up with data visualization solutions.

FarmWords: Children’s word learning app with entertaining, creative animation and music.
